description: Machine-readable app registry for the Ruflo monorepo. Single source of truth for docs, tooling, and lifecycle. Update when adding, retiring, or moving any entry under apps/, packages/, vendor/, or standalone roots.

lifecycleStates.active: Shipped product; listed on the family hub and in README; has CI and an owner.
lifecycleStates.incubating: In development behind a branch or feature flag; not yet listed as active.
lifecycleStates.maintenance: Shipped but not under active feature work; security/bug fixes only.
lifecycleStates.archived: Frozen reference; not developed further (e.g. scraped build kept for provenance).
lifecycleStates.superseded: Replaced by another entry; kept only to document the migration.
lifecycleStates.tooling: Internal skill/helper/daemon — not a user-facing app but part of delivery.
lifecycleStates.external: Standalone repo outside this monorepo; referenced for ecosystem completeness.

siteConvention: Each active app's marketing landing lives in <app>-site (static Next export, vercel.json framework=Other). Sites inherit lifecycle from their app unless overridden.
